category_edits.rationale: Scale each feed-forward residual contribution by 0.5 across all four category models while preserving attention, GELU, dimensions, normalization, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer. Explicit forward execution ensures identical scaling during training and inference; the predictor already imports this model class from train.py.

change_summary: Halve BERT4Rec feed-forward residual contributions in every category model, consistently during training and prediction, without changing checkpoint shapes.
